issues.body: `_pr_reachable` still uses `r"uses:\s*\./\.github/workflows/([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)"`, which requires `./.github/workflows/...` immediately after optional whitespace. GitHub Actions accepts quoted YAML scalars such as `uses: './.github/workflows/release.yml'` and `uses: "./.github/workflows/release.yml"`; those edges remain absent from `graph`. A PR-triggered workflow can therefore reach an allowlisted release workflow through a quoted call while `test_no_release_only_workflow_is_reachable_from_a_pr_trigger` stays green, contradicting the asserted fail-closed inertness proof. The transitive fixture uses unquoted `uses:` on both hops and does not cover this counterexample.
issues.fix_hint: Recognize unquoted references and correctly closed single- or double-quoted local workflow references, or parse the YAML scalar conservatively. Add regression cases with quoted edges, including a transitive quoted hop, and assert the release workflow is reachable. Ambiguous local `uses:` syntax should fail closed instead of being silently ignored.
issues.title: Reachability scan still misses quoted reusable-workflow calls

verdict.summary: Round 5 is stagnant: the round 4 major finding remains unchanged. `_pr_reachable` still recognizes only unquoted local reusable-workflow references, so valid single- or double-quoted `uses:` calls are omitted from the reachability graph. The asserted fail-closed inertness proof remains incomplete, and the regression fixture still covers only unquoted edges.
